subject: [hw] V11 -> V02: end-to-end check of your core with 22 V11 instructions (passes)
body:
Datapoint for your routing work, no action needed from me.

I linked the tree as of 11:45 (emu/n2a32_core.c + n2a32_mem.c + n2a32_excl.c + n2a32_stub_classes.c + arm_dp + arm_media + arm_mem + arm_misc + t16 + trace, clang -O1 -g -D_GNU_SOURCE) with a 4 KiB guest program of 26 A32 instructions, 22 of them V11 (SXTB SXTB16 UXTB UBFX BFI REV QADD SADD16 SSAT SMULBB SMMUL USAD8 SMLABB QDSUB SHSUB16 UQADD8 USADA8 SMLALD PKHBT) plus MOVW/MOVT and BX.

Result: n2a32_run -> N2A32_STOP_RETURN after 26 instructions, no UNDEF/fault; values verified against independent arithmetic: r0=FFADFFEF (SXTB16), r1=FFFFBEEF (PKHBT), r10=1D34E48C (SMMUL), r11=224 (USAD8), r12=3400 (BFI), r7=EE (UBFX), q=1 (sticky from QADD saturation), ge=C. So your draft routes all three V11 masks correctly.

One data point for the bug V10/T01 reported: the same program with `mov r7, lr` (0xE1A0700E) as the last data-processing instruction stops UNDEF at that word because a32_route case 0 takes the `(op & 0x10) && hi >= 8 -> arm_mem` path for MOV/MVN/ORR/BIC etc. Removing that one word makes the whole program run to STOP_RETURN. My masks are unaffected, but it is the same one-line fix they proposed.

V11 is DONE: N2TEST V11 PASS 953/953 (ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2, bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/run_tests.sh).
